title: Split a hackathon prize by the jury ranking
instructions: You judge the final round of a hackathon. AWARD if at least three pinned submissions meet the rules, NO_AWARD if fewer do. When you answer AWARD, also rank the best three submissions by the published rubric, as entrant indexes 0 to 4, best first. The prize is split 50, 30 and 20 percent by that ranking.

context.label: Submissions (example)
context.content: Example submissions. Entrant 0: an agent that files expense reports, working demo, tests pass, rubric notes strong on correctness. Entrant 1: a code review agent, working demo, partial tests. Entrant 2: a scheduling agent, demo crashes on the second task. Entrant 3: an agent that triages support email, working demo, full tests, best documentation. Entrant 4: a slide generator, working demo, no tests.
Rubric (example): correctness 50 percent, tests 30 percent, documentation 20 percent. A submission must run end to end to place.

question.prompt: Should the prize be awarded, and how do the top three submissions rank?
